snippet.title: The Undead Lawyer - Demo Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game to be notified of the demo release! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109120/The_Undead_Lawyer/

The Undead Lawyer is a hyper-movement, action puzzle game where you speed through the world to save the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!
